documented_value: 29 Scotch marine boilers: 24 double-ended (15ft 9in dia x 20ft long, 6 furnaces each) + 5 single-ended (15ft 9in dia x 11ft 9in long, 3 furnaces each) = 159 furnaces total. Working pressure 215 psi. Natural draught assisted by stokehold forced fans.

Two 4-cylinder, 4-crank triple expansion engines. HP: 54 in, IP: 84 in, two LP: 97 in dia. Stroke 75 in (6 ft 3 in). Stephenson link motion, Brown steam/hydraulic reversing engine. ~15,000 IHP each at 75 RPM.

One Parsons LP reaction turbine driving centre shaft, ~16,000 SHP at 165 RPM. Powered by exhaust steam from reciprocating LP cylinders. Ahead only. Equipped with automatic governor and changeover valves diverting exhaust to condensers when maneuvering/reversing.
Three propellers: Port & starboard wing screws: 3 blades, 23 ft 6 in diameter, cast bronze, outward-turning. Centre screw: 3 blades, 16 ft 6 in diameter, manganese bronze.
source: Harland & Wolff Engineering Order Book 401 & 2022 Magellan Digital Wreck Scan

documented_value: Four funnels, rake 1 in 12 (1 inch per foot aft). Oval section 24 ft 6 in x 19 ft. Height 175 ft above keel. Funnels 1, 2, 3 boiler exhausts (volumetric coal smoke). documented_value: Four 400 kW, 100V DC dynamos driven by vertical 3-crank compound steam engines in separate compartment abaft turbine room. Two 30 kW emergency dynamos on D deck. 10,000 incandescent lamps (tantalum & carbon). 562 electric heaters. 153 motors.

20 boats total: 14 Class A wooden lifeboats (30 ft x 9 ft x 4 ft, 65 persons each); 2 emergency cutters (25 ft x 7 ft 2 in, 40 persons each, swung outboard); 4 Engelhardt collapsible lifeboats (27 ft 5 in x 8 ft, 47 persons each: A & B on officers roof, C & D abreast cutters). 16 sets of Welin double-acting quadrant davits.
192 ft long enclosed steel weather screen on port and starboard forward A deck with 42 large sliding rectangular glazed windows.
